profile.name: Gamal Ahmed
profile.subtitle: Full-Stack Web Developer
profile.shortBio: I'm passionate about modern web technologies and creating fast, seamless, and scalable web applications for a superior user experience.
fullBio: Hello! I'm Gamal Ahmed, a dedicated Full Stack Developer with over 3 years of experience in building modern, scalable, and user-friendly web applications.

I started my journey with front-end development, mastering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React. With time, I expanded my expertise to back-end technologies such as Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, which enabled me to build complete, end-to-end solutions that deliver real value to users.
I'm passionate about writing clean, maintainable code and crafting seamless digital experiences. My goal is to develop applications that are fast, secure, easy to use, and optimized for performance.

projects.title: Sky – 3D Interactive Weather Application
projects.tagline: Real-Time 3D Weather Globe with Interactive Spatial Visualizations & Global Atmospheric Data
projects.description: Interactive 3D weather globe application visualizing real-time global weather conditions, forecasts, and atmospheric metrics with smooth WebGL animations.
projects.overview: Sky is an immersive 3D weather visualization platform built with React, Three.js / WebGL globe rendering, and real-time OpenWeather / atmospheric APIs. It enables users to explore global climate data on an interactive 3D globe, view city-specific hourly and 7-day forecasts, atmospheric pressure, wind velocity, humidity, and UV levels with fluid camera transitions and responsive controls.
projects.problem: Traditional weather websites display flat tables and static maps that lack spatial intuition, making it hard to visualize global weather patterns and real-time regional climate dynamics.
projects.solution: Engineered an interactive 3D WebGL globe utilizing Three.js and high-performance coordinate mapping (latitude/longitude to 3D sphere vectors), real-time weather API integration, dynamic daylight/night shading, and an ultra-responsive glassmorphism interface.
projects.role: Lead Frontend & 3D Web Developer. Implemented the 3D globe scene, sphere coordinate raycasting for location selection, OpenWeather API data fetching pipeline, responsive UI layout, and smooth camera tween animations.
projects.impact: Delivered silky-smooth 60 FPS globe rendering across desktop and mobile devices, with instant geolocation lookup and comprehensive multi-metric weather telemetry.

features.title: Interactive 3D Globe Navigation
features.desc: Orbit, pan, and zoom freely with intuitive touch and mouse gestures, featuring real-time day/night terminator lighting.

features.title: Real-Time Global Weather Metrics
features.desc: Instant temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind direction & speed, visibility, and UV index tracking for any global coordinate.

features.title: Predictive 7-Day & Hourly Forecasts
features.desc: Granular meteorological trend cards and interactive graphs for upcoming weather conditions.

features.title: City Search & Geolocation
features.desc: Instant search autocomplete with coordinates raycasting directly to the 3D globe location marker.

projects.title: PizzaHouse – Online Food Ordering & Delivery App
projects.tagline: Fast, Modern Stone-Baked Pizza Ordering System with Real-Time Cart & Customization
projects.description: Modern, responsive food ordering application featuring stone-baked pizzas, interactive customization, fast delivery dispatch, and seamless cart state management.
projects.overview: PizzaHouse (بيتزا هاوس الساخنة) is a high-performance food ordering and delivery web application designed to offer customers a frictionless ordering journey. It showcases artisan stone-baked pizzas, sides, and beverages with dynamic topping customization, real-time pricing calculation, localized Arabic/English support, fast delivery countdown, and a responsive checkout experience.
projects.problem: Restaurant owners were losing up to 30% revenue to delivery aggregator fees and needed a bespoke ordering platform tailored to their menu customization workflows.
projects.solution: Engineered an end-to-end full-stack solution featuring Redux Toolkit for complex cart state, an Express order management API with rate limiting, and MongoDB collections for automated receipt generation.
projects.role: Full-Stack Developer. Designed the modern UI/UX with responsive mobile-first layouts, engineered the cart state with Redux Toolkit, created API endpoints, and optimized page load times.
projects.impact: Achieved 100% mobile-friendly responsive experience, sub-second cart updates with persistent storage, and streamlined the ordering flow to under 60 seconds.

features.title: Artisan Menu & Category Filtering
features.desc: Browse stone-baked pizzas, sides, deals, and desserts with instant category switching and search.

features.title: Interactive Pizza Customization
features.desc: Interactive crust, sauce, cheese, and topping selection with instant visual feedback and dynamic pricing.

features.title: Persistent Cart & Smart Checkout
features.desc: Redux Toolkit powered cart with local persistence, promo codes, delivery fee calculations, and fast checkout.

features.title: Bilingual Arabic & English UI
features.desc: Seamless localization with tailored RTL typography and fluid mobile animations.

projects.title: JobMatch AI – Smart ATS Resume Analyzer & Builder
projects.tagline: Build & Optimize Resumes That Pass Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) with Instant AI Feedback
projects.description: AI-powered resume optimization tool that analyzes CVs against ATS criteria, scores keyword alignment, and provides instant actionable recommendations.
projects.overview: JobMatch AI is an intelligent resume optimization platform designed to help job seekers bypass Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and land more interviews. By parsing resume documents and comparing them against target job descriptions, JobMatch AI delivers real-time ATS compatibility scores, identifies missing critical keywords, validates formatting compliance (ISO A4, single-column standards), and suggests impactful professional phrasing.
projects.problem: Over 75% of resumes are automatically rejected by ATS algorithms before a human recruiter ever sees them due to non-compliant formatting, missing keywords, or poor semantic structure.
projects.solution: Engineered an AI-assisted analysis engine built with Next.js, Node.js/Express, and Tailwind CSS that evaluates resume content in real-time, provides visual scoring breakdowns (Keywords, Format, Impact), and exports ATS-friendly single-column PDFs.
projects.role: Full-Stack Developer. Built the Next.js frontend with interactive scoring dials and real-time document preview, developed document parsing and keyword extraction algorithms, and implemented export pipelines.
projects.impact: Empowered candidates to boost ATS readiness scores from ~54% to 94%+, drastically increasing interview callback rates.

features.title: Instant ATS Readiness Scoring
features.desc: Real-time score (0-100) evaluating keyword density, formatting compliance, and impact metrics.

features.title: Skill Alignment & Missing Keyword Matrix
features.desc: Visual breakdown comparing resume skills against industry job requirements with matched and missing badges.

features.title: ATS-Friendly PDF Export
features.desc: Clean single-column layout generator adhering to ISO A4 standard and machine-readable typography.

features.title: Live In-Browser Document Preview
features.desc: Interactive simulated document inspector showing line-by-line feedback and optimization tips.

projects.title: Event Management & Reservation Dashboard
projects.tagline: Comprehensive Event Ticketing, Attendance Analytics & Revenue Management
projects.description: Centralized administrative portal for tracking event registrations, ticketing quotas, attendee check-ins, and revenue.
projects.overview: An end-to-end event management dashboard that streamlines ticket distribution, attendee quotas, registration tracking, and financial analytics for corporate conferences and cultural events.
projects.problem: Organizers were losing track of ticket sales and attendee quotas using fragmented spreadsheets, causing check-in bottlenecks and revenue reconciliation errors.
projects.solution: Designed an administrative dashboard with real-time quota tracking, MongoDB aggregations for analytics charts, and unique QR ticket verification endpoints.
projects.role: Developed administrative dashboard with React, Tailwind UI, Express backend controllers, and MongoDB aggregations.
projects.impact: Automated ticket tracking, eliminated manual spreadsheet errors, and slashed check-in wait times by 60%.

features.title: Real-Time Quota & Revenue Analytics
features.desc: Interactive KPI widgets tracking gross sales, available capacity, and ticket tier velocity.

features.title: Multi-Tier Ticket Management
features.desc: Custom pricing brackets (Early Bird, VIP, Student) with automated expiration triggers.

features.title: Fast QR Check-in System
features.desc: Sub-second attendee badge scanning and check-in confirmation to eliminate venue congestion.

features.title: CSV/PDF Export Center
features.desc: One-click export of financial reconciliations and attendee manifest reports.

projects.title: AI Conversational Support Assistant
projects.tagline: Intelligent Real-Time Chat Assistant with Streaming Responses & Intent Recognition
projects.description: Intelligent customer query assistant with real-time response streaming, intent recognition, and smooth error recovery.
projects.overview: An AI-powered customer support chatbot web interface built to deliver instant, contextual responses to customer inquiries. Designed with streaming message rendering, keyboard shortcuts, and intelligent fallback to human agents.
projects.problem: Customer service teams faced heavy queue delays answering repetitive inquiries during peak hours, leading to frustrated users.
projects.solution: Engineered a Next.js streaming interface with Server-Sent Events (SSE), markdown code syntax highlighting, conversation session persistence, and smart intent categorization.
projects.role: Implemented Next.js frontend with streaming response state, input debounce, and fallback error handlers.
projects.impact: Handled 65% of incoming inquiries automatically, achieving 24/7 coverage with an average response speed under 1.2s.

features.title: Token-by-Token Streaming Output
features.desc: Smooth typing effect with real-time token rendering for an instant conversational feel.

features.title: Syntax-Highlighted Code Blocks
features.desc: Formatted code snippets with one-click copy and language detection for developer assistance.

features.title: Suggested Smart Prompts
features.desc: Contextual chips helping users resolve common questions in a single click.

features.title: Seamless Human Handoff
features.desc: Graceful escalation to human support agents when complex or sensitive inquiries arise.
